message.content: In the discussion on the 20260410_11:00 entry, WolfgangSchulz suggests trying a classic song like "Stand By Me" for their jam session. LiHua agrees and proposes this song, as it has a great rhythm that everyone can join in on. YurikoYamamoto expresses her enthusiasm for the idea, stating that they could explore a song that has a nice groove. Therefore, "Stand By Me" appears to be the song LiHua suggested for the jam session on 20260405.
